> We demonstrate ojs treemaps.

```{ojs}
// Load D3
//import * as d3 from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/+esm"

// Define dimensions
height = 400

// Example hierarchical data
data = ({
  name: "root",
  children: [
    { name: "A", value: 120 },
    { name: "B", value: 80 },
    { name: "C", value: 50 },
    {
      name: "Group D",
      children: [
        { name: "D1", value: 40 },
        { name: "D2", value: 30 },
        { name: "D3", value: 20 }
      ]
    }
  ]
})

// Build hierarchy and calculate layout
root = {
  const h = d3.hierarchy(data)
    .sum(d => d.value)
    .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

  return d3.treemap()
    .size([width, height])
    .padding(2)
    .round(true)
    .tile(d3.treemapSquarify)(h);
}

// Color scale
color = d3.scaleOrdinal(d3.schemeCategory10)

// SVG container
chart = {
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .style("font-family", "sans-serif")
      .style("cursor", "pointer");

  const g = svg.append("g");

  draw(root);

  function draw(node) {
    g.selectAll("*").remove(); // Clear previous elements on redraw

    const leaves = g.selectAll("g.node")
      .data(node.children || [])
      .join("g")
      .attr("class", "node")
      .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.x0},${d.y0})`)
      .on("click", (event, d) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (d.children) {
          // Re-layout zoomed node to fill current view if desired, or zoom
          zoom(d);
        }
      });

    leaves.append("rect")
      .attr("width", d => d.x1 - d.x0)
      .attr("height", d => d.y1 - d.y0)
      .attr("fill", d => color(d.data.name));

    leaves.append("text")
      .attr("x", 4)
      .attr("y", 16)
      .text(d => d.data.name)
      .style("fill", "white")
      .style("font-size", "12px");
  }

  function zoom(node) {
    const x = width / (node.x1 - node.x0);
    const y = height / (node.y1 - node.y0);

    g.transition().duration(750)
      .attr("transform", `translate(${-node.x0 * x},${-node.y0 * y}) scale(${x},${y})`);
  }

  return svg.node();
}
```
